definitions.gloss: manju, steamed bun with sweet filling
definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese confection consisting of a wheat or rice flour outer layer filled with sweet bean paste (anko).

examples.japanese: ⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧{饅頭|まんじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}いました→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought onsen manju as a souvenir.

notes:
TYPES:
- ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧{饅頭|まんじゅう}: brown-skinned manju sold at hot-spring resorts, a common souvenir
- ⟦{紅白|こうはく}→紅白：13805_kouhaku⟧{饅頭|まんじゅう}: a red and a white manju, given at celebrations
- ⟦{薄皮|うすかわ}→薄皮：28916_usukawa⟧{饅頭|まんじゅう}: thin-skinned manju
- {酒|さか}{饅頭|まんじゅう}: dough leavened with sake yeast
- {葛|くず}{饅頭|まんじゅう}: translucent kudzu-starch wrapper, a summer sweet

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{餡子|あんこ}→餡子：08654_anko⟧: the usual filling, either こし{餡|あん} (smooth) or {粒餡|つぶあん} (chunky)

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Manju came to Japan from China. 「{饅頭|まんじゅう}こわい」 is a well-known rakugo story in which a man claims to be terrified of manju so that others will pelt him with them.
